text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI solutions in Python.

While my background is in ML and NLP rather than Midjourney specifically, I’m comfortable working in AI-driven systems and collaborating closely with creative teams to turn ideas into reliable outputs. I work with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning workflows, so I’m used to structured experimentation, prompt-driven iteration, and improving results through testing and refinement.

A few relevant projects:
- Telecom churn prediction: I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. It reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and delivered 3.1x top-decile lift.
- Clinical note summarisation: I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model that drafts visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs are masked. It achieved ROUGE-L 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

I understand you’re looking for someone fluent in English, strong in AI art workflows, and comfortable with Midjourney, cyberpunk, anime, and comic book styles. If you’re open to someone who can contribute from the AI/ML side and work well with your design process, I’d be glad to help support your team.

AWS2022

I’d approach this with clear communication, careful iteration, and a focus on matching style requirements closely. If needed, I can adapt quickly to your preferred workflow and provide thoughtful collaboration as your team grows.
